tasks.subject: Task 5: AI router (generate() orchestration)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Single public AI entry point. Iterates providers in order, preempts exhaustion, streams tokens, writes telemetry on completion.

**Files:**
- Create: lib/ai/router.ts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] generate({ prompt, systemPrompt, feature, userId }) returns { textStream, providerUsed }
- [ ] Iterates cerebras → groq → cloudflare → deepseek
- [ ] Skips unconfigured or capped providers (preempts 429)
- [ ] Per-provider catch routes to next tier
- [ ] On success: increments daily + minute counters, writes telemetry
- [ ] On exhaustion: throws AIProvidersExhaustedError with attempts list
- [ ] wrapStream finalizer runs post-completion bookkeeping
- [ ] pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build clean

**Verify:** pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build

```json:metadata
{"files":["lib/ai/router.ts"],"verifyCommand":"pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build","acceptanceCriteria":["generate() orchestrates 4 providers","preempts via rate-limit","wrapStream handles bookkeeping","exhaustion throws AIProvidersExhaustedError","build clean"]}
```
